title: How I fixed Claude's memory with a custom skill.
description:
Claude forgets everything after 20 messages. So I built a file that tells it exactly what to remember when a chat gets too long; the goal, the decisions, what's pending and tone.

Now I just type "handoff" and it carries everything into the next chat.

Comment "skill" and I'll send you the setup.
